descriptionDraft:
Keep the next useful step close to hand. This illustrated companion brings together 44 vegetable growing guides for UK gardeners, with practical advice from sowing and planting to harvesting and storage.

Compare varieties, check seasonal calendars and find the space, sun, water and nutrition each crop needs. Clear planting illustrations and short reminder banners help you return to the essential jobs as the season progresses.

When a crop struggles, use the illustrated Troubles guides to compare symptoms and find practical organic ways to respond and prevent problems. Crop labels help you check which advice applies.

Designed in a compact 185 x 240 mm format, this is a book to consult through the growing season: for choosing what to grow, planning the next sowing and understanding what your plants are telling you.
